description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerIpcMock for unit testing, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface for Web Audio Player IPC in the Rialto client component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface for testing purposes.
